تستأنسي (form X)
# تَسْتَأْنِسِي (tastaʔnisī) /tas.taʔ.ni.siː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
# تُسْتَأْنَسِي (tustaʔnasī) /tus.taʔ.na.siː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
